details: Node bootstrap now starts balance-history after Bitcoin reaches the signed snapshot or network origin stable height plus the release-frozen BTC stable lag, without waiting for IBD and txindex completion.
The controller starts usdb-indexer once balance-history is query-ready with a committed USDB origin, allowing both historical indexers to catch up while Bitcoin completes synchronization.

Snapshot block hash is checked at the stable anchor height, independently from the higher minimum Bitcoin tip gate; mismatches and unverified snapshot state fail closed, while USDB chain startup still rechecks full consensus readiness.
summary: Pipeline Bitcoin and historical indexer bootstrap without relaxing chain readiness
